context:
Goal: degen lanes ship fast, with the native checks run once per batch.
Problem (goal): runner 9 in the cloud batches degen today, but the Mac must still run native-check and the iPhone ship check (owed for #460). Runner 9 needs your word on who batches next.
Based on (read): degen rule tests-once-per-batch: the full Swift suite runs once per batch, on the Mac.
Based on (measured): the Mac runs another Claude account, so cloud sessions cannot message it; triage relays its PRs by hand (#1364).
Departs from: main, runner 9 (cloud) batches and merges degen; changes to the Mac session batching and merging degen.

lastAnswer.note: Owner (page comment, 17:17 CST): the Mac merges degen almost always; runner 9 only merges claude-settings changes that apply to the child repos. Runner 9 hands #454 to the Mac's next batch.

options.gain: One session runs native-check, the iPhone ship check and the merge, with no hand-offs.
options.label: The Mac batches degen
options.lose: Cloud lanes can't message the Mac, so each lane's PR reaches it through you or triage.

options.gain: Lanes keep handing off to runner 9 as today.
options.label: Runner 9 keeps batching degen
options.lose: Each batch with a native change still waits on a Mac run of native-check.

reply: Done: a, as you said in your comment at 17:17 CST. The Mac merges degen. Runner 9 merges only claude-settings changes in the child repos, and hands #454 to the Mac's next batch.
title: Should the Mac run degen batches from now on?
why: Runner 9 holds degen #454 (review passed) and needs to know who batches it.
